preamble: The voiced postalveolar fricative [ʒ] is fronted to the alveolar [z]. In Latvian the East Baltic *ž (Lithuanian ž) became z, the voiced counterpart of the š > s merger (Lithuanian žiemà, Latvian ziema 'winter'). Polish mazurzenie is filed under the retroflex cell ʐ → z (cz/sz/ż/dż [t͡ʂ ʂ ʐ d͡ʐ] > c/s/z/dz), not here.

examples.note: Voiced counterpart of the š > s merger
